title: Frontier Checkpoint
premise: A long drama of passenger and cargo inspection at the port. Ashu and Agang are easily confused by looks; the clearance terminal goes intact→shattered screen→replaced; after the border-check pickup is wrecked it must be avoided; lead-seal/radio/bell count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.

states.prime_on_duty: Border officer Zhou Li around forty, peaked cap, deep-blue uniform, badge on the chest, gaze sharp.
states.weary_injured: The same Zhou Li: uniform torn, temple bandaged, walking slowly on a cane, peaked cap still straight.
states.retired_exit: Zhou Li has left the post; only his old uniform and peaked cap remain in the hall—he himself no longer appears.

states.young_apprentice: Trainee Ashu of fifteen or sixteen, indigo armband, light-gray trainee uniform, eyes bright and stubborn.
states.adult_successor: Ashu in his early twenties, still in indigo armband, tall upright and steady.

states.online_intact: A desktop clearance terminal, black case green screen, customs emblem sticker on the side, card slot intact.
states.screen_shattered: The same clearance terminal with a shattered screen, green text garbled, card slot jammed with paper.
states.screen_replaced: Clearance terminal online again after a new screen; a service sticker on the case.

states.intact: A hardback inspection ledger noting plates, cargo names, and release stamps.
states.rain_ruined: The same inspection ledger soaked by a downpour; cover wrinkled, stamps bled.

states.intact: A deep-blue border-check pickup, roof warning lights, white 'Border-12' sprayed on the door.
states.ram_wrecked: Border-check pickup rammed by a gate-runner truck; nose crumpled, lights shattered—a wreck.

states.young_rival: Young Agang of build close to Ashu's, milky-white armband, same light-gray trainee uniform, manner bold.
states.remade_scarred: Remade Agang still wears the milky-white armband, manner deeper.

E7.name: passenger hall
E7.appearance: Passenger hall: high windows, blue queue rails, clearance desks in a row, soft PA announcements.

E8.name: cargo lane
E8.appearance: Cargo lane: truck lane under a rain canopy, weighbridge and lead-seal table side by side, diesel smell thick.

E9.name: border trade market
E9.appearance: Border trade market: open-air market outside the port, stalls selling local goods, noisy crowds.

E10.name: old sentry porch
E10.appearance: Old sentry porch: gray-brick former sentry post, lintel carved 'Frontier Guard', mossy stone steps.

E11.name: memorial brass plaque
E11.appearance: A brass memorial plaque nailed to the porch pillar, engraved with Zhou Li's name and enlistment year.

E12.name: lead seals
E12.appearance: Three red lead seals on iron wire on the seal table, faces stamped with the customs emblem.

E13.name: green postal van
E13.appearance: A green postal van, rounded body without 'Border-12' lettering—unlike the deep-blue pickup.

E14.name: customs supervisor
E14.appearance: A lean customs supervisor in white gloves with a supervisor badge, build like Zhou Li's but more stiff.

E15.name: handheld radios
E15.appearance: A row of five handheld radios on a charging rack, green lights all on, numbered shells.

E16.name: warning copper bells
E16.appearance: Two warning copper bells hung under the lane canopy, struck when something is wrong.

E17.name: Xiaolan
E17.appearance: Market girl Xiaolan, light-brown headscarf, at a glance like young Ashu, shy eyes.

E18.name: training dummy terminal
E18.appearance: A training dummy terminal, smaller, gray screen without emblem—resembles the clearance terminal but cannot go online.

E19.name: freight driver Lao Jin
E19.appearance: Freight driver Lao Jin, full beard, camo jacket, build like Zhou Li's but stockier.

features.E2: Ashu: indigo armband, light-gray trainee uniform.
features.E6: Agang: face nearly identical to Ashu's, but milky-white armband and bold manner.

lookalike_pairs.note: Trainee misID: indigo armband vs milky-white armband.

scenes.setting: Passenger hall dusk (introduce five radios · two copper bells)
actions: At dusk Zhou Li enters the passenger hall and first checks the clearance terminal on the desk.

actions.action: A row of five handheld radios on the charging rack shows green lights all on; Zhou Li test-calls each one.
Two warning copper bells hang under the cargo canopy; Zhou Li taps lightly to test the ring.

actions: Zhou Li circles the clearance desk checking whether the card slot is clean.
Through high windows Zhou Li looks toward the darkening cargo-lane canopy.

actions.action: The clearance terminal green screen is steady; Zhou Li nods confirmation.

actions: Zhou Li sits in the duty chair in a hall corner and dozes.

scenes.setting: Logging the inspection ledger
actions: Zhou Li opens the inspection ledger and notes that day's released runs.
Zhou Li stamps a release chop in the inspection ledger.
Zhou Li closes the inspection ledger and returns it to the clearance-desk drawer.

actions.action: The clearance terminal beeps briefly; Zhou Li nods.

actions: Zhou Li dry-cloths fingerprints from the ledger cover.

scenes.setting: Cargo lane greets the trainee (introduce three lead seals)
actions: At dawn on the cargo lane Zhou Li greets young Ashu driving the border-check pickup up.

actions.action: Ashu jumps down from the pickup and flips the warning lights to steady flash.
Zhou Li points to the three red lead seals on the seal table, teaching Ashu to read the emblem face.
Ashu crouches by the weighbridge, curiously watching the digits jump.
Zhou Li explains ram-response procedure; Ashu nods earnestly.
Ashu looks back at the deep-blue border-check pickup, eyes full of tension.

actions: Zhou Li has Ashu practice radio call signs first.

scenes.setting: Border trade market (Agang alone)
actions: In the noisy border trade market, Agang in a milky-white armband looks up from behind a stall.
Agang checks invoices at a local-goods stall; the armband stands out.
Agang argues with a stallholder, manner bold.
Agang carries a bodycam through the market crowd.
Agang stops at the market mouth and looks back toward the port.

scenes.setting: Trainees shared frame
actions: At the cargo-lane mouth Ashu and Agang stand side by side—one indigo armband, one milky-white.
Ashu hands a lead seal to Agang; they check the number.
Agang tightens Ashu's armband; the two walk slowly under the canopy.
Ashu and Agang part at the lane end—one to the hall, one to the market.
Diesel wind skims past; their similar light-gray trainee uniforms cross between rails then split.

scenes.setting: Inspection ledger rain-ruined
actions: Months later at night Zhou Li alone stands night watch in the passenger hall.

actions.action: Zhou Li opens the inspection ledger and finds rain through the window has soaked and wrinkled the cover.

actions: Zhou Li wipes water beads from the clearance terminal screen.
Zhou Li looks toward the black cargo canopy.

actions.action: The clearance terminal green screen glows faintly; Zhou Li stares at empty queue numbers.

actions: Zhou Li clips blotting paper into the ruined ledger and weights it under an iron rule.

scenes.setting: Port seasons of daily work (filler · stretch the interval)
actions: In rainy season Zhou Li wipes damp passport trays dry in the passenger hall.
Zhou Li brushes dust from the card slot with a soft brush.
At dawn Zhou Li checks the duty roster on the cargo lane.
Zhou Li hangs a raincoat on a canopy post and listens to weighbridge hydraulics.
In midsummer Zhou Li turns on the hall AC to drive out the heat.
Zhou Li calibrates the clearance terminal clock.
When autumn wind rises Zhou Li checks reflective strips on the lane rails.
Zhou Li trial-writes new cargo-class codes on a blank ledger page.
On a frost night Zhou Li lights an emergency lamp and checks flashlight charge.
Zhou Li wraps the lead-seal box in a blanket against night dew.
On a heavy snow day Zhou Li sweeps thin snow from the old sentry porch steps.
Zhou Li blows on his hands and tightens lead-seal iron wire.
In early spring Zhou Li clears weeds from the wind-shaft vents.
Zhou Li charges and tests the five handheld radios one by one.
Zhou Li posts new clearance notices on the hall wall.
Around Dragon Boat Festival Zhou Li fumigates the archive cabinet with mugwort smoke.
Zhou Li redraws the lead-seal faces clear.
Zhou Li alone paces the cargo lane, silently reciting ram-response call signs.
After rain Zhou Li opens the side door and listens to eaves drip into an iron bucket.
Zhou Li swaps worn gloves for new ones.
Another dusk Zhou Li sits by the terminal listening to the PA.
At night Zhou Li rises to charge the hall emergency lamps.
Zhou Li numbers newly arrived passport trays.
Zhou Li polishes the 'Frontier Guard' lintel on the porch.
Zhou Li checks the pickup warning-light bulbs.
Zhou Li marks priority runs on the duty sheet.
Zhou Li wrings mud-stained rags and hangs them up.
On a full-moon night Zhou Li looks out at the lane; canopy silver light.
Zhou Li tidies the charging rack so radio numbers face out.
Zhou Li writes a new season's inspection notes on the ledger flyleaf.
Zhou Li polishes the two warning copper bells bright.
Zhou Li hears market noise and keeps logging releases.
Zhou Li glues a cracked rail sleeve back.
Zhou Li stacks obsolete forms for destruction in a hall corner.
Zhou Li latches the side door against night cold wind into the hall.
Another Qingming Zhou Li sets a bunch of wildflowers on the porch.
Zhou Li rolls the duty sheet into a tube and binds it with a rubber band.
Zhou Li tests a low copper-bell tone; the sound is clear.
Zhou Li sits silent in the hall, listening to the PA loop for a long time.
Zhou Li cuts worn indigo armband cloth into rag stock.
Zhou Li tightens the dust cap on the weighbridge sensor port.

scenes.setting: Cargo patrol (recall lead seals · postal-van false friend)
actions: At daybreak Zhou Li patrols the cargo lane; the border-check pickup sits under the canopy.

actions.action: Zhou Li crouches to check the pickup tire pressure.
Zhou Li walks to the seal table; those three red lead seals are still on iron wire.
A green postal van drives the lane, rounded body—not the border-check pickup.
Zhou Li stands on the cargo lane and logs the weighbridge calibration.
Zhou Li hangs a wet raincoat on a canopy wooden rack.

actions: Zhou Li pats mud dots from his sleeve and looks back at hall lights.

scenes.setting: Inspection daily addenda (filler · keep stretching the interval)
actions: After Grain Rain Zhou Li teaches a new trainee on the cargo lane to tell real lead seals from fake.
Zhou Li refolds the dried raincoat into the pickup toolbox.
In summer heat Zhou Li lays a wet cloth on the terminal shell to cool it.
Zhou Li checks the pickup bed and moves the damp lead-seal box to the upper tier.
On an autumn night Zhou Li mends loose ledger pages under an emergency lamp.
Zhou Li rotates the five handheld radios out for inspection.
At first snow Zhou Li sweeps a narrow path on the porch threshold.
Zhou Li crates the training dummy terminal again.
Zhou Li hears copper bells chime lightly and keeps approving shift handovers.
Zhou Li opens the side door to let draft blow diesel smell away.
Zhou Li hangs rain canvas on the porch.
Zhou Li stows a blown fuse in an iron box.
At night Zhou Li dreams of a failed ram stop and writes it into the ledger on waking.
Zhou Li rinses the lead-seal table with clean water.
Zhou Li wipes and reposts the clearance notices.
Zhou Li pulls weeds from lane stone seams.
Zhou Li returns radios to the charging rack; number stickers somewhat faded.
Before lights-out Zhou Li looks once more at the terminal green light.
Zhou Li folds an indigo armband a trainee left in the hall.
Zhou Li hears the market closing horn and rises to lock up.
Zhou Li dries gloves by the heater.
Zhou Li moves the copper bells aside to show the repaired canopy beam.
Zhou Li dries temperature-check stickers.
Zhou Li charts release-volume comparisons on the ledger last page.
Zhou Li silently recites tomorrow's priority runs and steps from the porch.
Zhou Li pushes the pickup to the wall to clear the lane.
Zhou Li hears a distant whistle and blows out the emergency lamp.
Another rain night Zhou Li alone watches the terminal until dawn.
Zhou Li bags newly issued reflective vests into paper sacks.

scenes.setting: Ram night (terminal shattered · pickup wrecked)
actions: On a storm night a truck suddenly rams the gate; alarms scream.
In the shock the clearance desk sways hard.

actions.action: A sharp crack—the clearance terminal screen shatters into garbled green.
Under the canopy the deep-blue border-check pickup intercepts head-on.
The border-check pickup is flipped; nose crumpled, lights shattered—totally wrecked.
Zhou Li lunges to the clearance desk and clutches the shattered-screen terminal.

actions: Reinforcements arrive with lamps; glass shards litter the lane.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (pickup indirect · radio recall)

actions.action: Next day Zhou Li stands in the passenger hall, staring at the shattered-screen clearance terminal.
Zhou Li fingertips the cracked glass, expression dark.
In a blank of the inspection ledger Zhou Li notes the date the border-check pickup was hit.
On the wall still hangs a dispatch photo of the border-check pickup; Zhou Li gazes a long time.
Zhou Li takes one of the five handheld radios from the charging rack and test-calls the duty room.
The shattered-screen clearance terminal still flickers garbled green on the rails.

actions: Zhou Li sets muddy boots by the door to drain.

scenes.setting: Screen replaced (third state · dummy-terminal false friend)
actions: Weeks later Zhou Li calls a technician to replace the clearance terminal screen.

actions.action: Zhou Li takes a training dummy terminal from the training room for comparison—smaller, gray screen without emblem.

actions: The technician fits a new screen and retests the network.

actions.action: Replacement done; the clearance terminal is online again with a service sticker on the case.

actions: The repaired terminal beeps clear; Zhou Li exhales.
Zhou Li swipes a card for a trial release; the green light comes on.

scenes.setting: False friends: postal van and supervisor

actions.action: freight driver Lao Jin arrives on the lane in a camo jacket, build like Zhou Li's.
customs supervisor also arrives in white gloves with a badge and talks beside Zhou Li.
The supervisor points at the green postal van, asking if it belongs to the border mobile unit.
The supervisor leaves; Zhou Li alone remains on the cargo lane.

actions: Lao Jin hands over a waybill and bows farewell.

scenes.setting: False friend: Xiaolan who resembles Ashu

actions.action: A girl named Xiaolan in a light-brown headscarf arrives at the market; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Ashu.
Xiaolan practices sorting stall invoices; Zhou Li shakes his head—she is never Ashu.

actions: Xiaolan shyly lowers her head and tightens the headscarf.

scenes.setting: Weary injured (bell long-range recall)

actions.action: At dusk years later, Zhou Li with a bandaged temple leans on a cane on the old sentry porch.

actions: Zhou Li looks up at the 'Frontier Guard' lintel, gaze far away.

actions.action: Those two warning copper bells from the canopy are moved to the porch for a test ring; Zhou Li stops to listen.

actions: Zhou Li presses a palm to the porch's cold brick wall, as if saying goodbye.
Evening wind lifts the torn corner of his uniform.

scenes.setting: Ashu takes over · Zhou Li retires

actions.action: By day adult Ashu returns along the side road and hurries toward the old sentry porch.

actions: Ashu reunites with cane-leaning Zhou Li under the porch; they embrace.

actions.action: Beside the duty-room couch Ashu holds Zhou Li's hand.
Zhou Li's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and exits the post.
Ashu folds Zhou Li's old uniform neat and sets it by the pillow.

scenes.setting: Relics · memorial brass plaque (indirect mention)

actions.action: Zhou Li's peaked cap still hangs behind the hall door; Ashu reaches to stroke it lightly.
On the porch pillar Ashu stands before a newly nailed memorial brass plaque.
Ashu's fingertip traces Zhou Li's name engraved on the plaque.

actions: Ashu sets a bunch of wildflowers under the plaque.

scenes.setting: Rival reunion (long-range + shared frame)

actions.action: Remade Agang arrives from the market and embraces Ashu tightly under the porch.

actions: Ashu and Agang stand side by side on the porch—one calm-eyed, one deep-mannered.
They look at each other in silence, facing similar faces.
Agang tightens his milky-white armband; Ashu still wears the indigo armband.

scenes.setting: Memory flashback (temporal locate)

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—that youth practicing radio call signs on the cargo lane appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth practicing radio call signs on the cargo lane

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the hall, a black-case green-screen terminal lights steady for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the black-case green-screen terminal that first lit steady at the opening

actions.action: Flash to the market years ago—that light-gray figure in a milky-white armband slips past.

anchor.phrase: the light-gray figure in a milky-white armband in the market years ago

actions.action: Again that row of five radios on the charging rack.

anchor.phrase: that row of five handheld radios on the charging rack

actions.action: Back to the canopy truck lane of first meeting, canopy dripping as before.

anchor.phrase: the cargo lane of first meeting

actions.action: Again the image of those two old bells under the canopy chiming lightly.

anchor.phrase: those two warning copper bells under the canopy

scenes.setting: Closing (ledger long range · lead-seal long range)

actions.action: Ashu reopens that rain-ruined inspection ledger and walks into the passenger hall.
On the seal table those three red lead seals are still on iron wire.
Ashu takes over the screen-replaced clearance terminal and swipes cards for release again.

actions: New green sprouts from porch stone seams.
Ashu tightens his indigo armband; hall lights come on again.
